source_semantics.visibility: AppBulkActionBar exists only for a positive SelectedCount; the clear control exists only when ClearRequested has a delegate.
source_semantics.busy_guard: The source clear button is disabled while Busy and ClearAsync returns without invoking ClearRequested while Busy.
source_semantics.effect: ClearAsync publishes only the caller-owned clear callback. It does not persist, call WordPress, submit a form, enqueue work, or claim external success.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The shared React control is absent for an empty selection or missing callback, is disabled while the Sites mutation boundary is busy, and clears only the local selected-ID set.
laravel_adaptation.authoritative_read: The production Sites consumer derives selectable rows from the existing tenant-scoped sites API and does not manufacture site state.
laravel_adaptation.mutation_boundary: Clearing selection issues no request. Existing delete request/confirmation operations remain separate canonical mutation boundaries.
laravel_adaptation.authorization_guard: The Sites production consumer renders only when the frontend context includes sites.manage (or wildcard) and does not start its tenant sites read when that permission is absent.
